sourceSentences: Singed flings the target enemy 550 units over himself, dealing magic damage.
If the target lands on Mega Adhesive area of effect after the displacement, they are rooted for a duration.
During Fling cast time (the windup not during the actual fling) the enemy's flash is already locked, making it a non reactable spell.
Fling can throw enemies over walls (circumstances permitting).
Slow-immune enemies will not be rooted when flung into Mega Adhesive.
Singed spills a potent adhesive that lands at the target location after 0.375 seconds, creating a field for 3 seconds that grounds enemies within and slows them.
The goo missile is a projectile. It has a fixed travel time but is independent from when the zone is established. It is destructible by effects such as Wind Wall
Mega Adhesive's slow and ground debuffs are each marked as non-dispellable, so they are not removed by most cleanses.
Singed earns the kill credit of enemy minions that are poisoned and would die to the damage of allied minions within the time before the next damage instance.
During this time, Poison Trail additionally applies Grievous Wounds for 1 second, which refreshes every 0.25 seconds while the poison persists.
The ideal teamfight combo is: activate Insanity Potion, Ghost into the enemy backline
then Fling the carry into your team or into the Mega Adhesive for a guaranteed root.
slowing enemies by 50/55/60/65/70% and grounding them, preventing all dashes and blinks.
toggle Q on and run through the minion wave to poison all minions while positioning for CS.
Poison Trail also grants minion kill credit if poisoned minions die to allied minion damage.
Flash behind an enemy and immediately E to fling them into your team or into Mega Adhesive for a guaranteed root.
Cast Mega Adhesive (W) behind you, then Fling (E): a target flung into the glue is rooted there.
Cast Mega Adhesive (W) under an enemy who has a dash: in the glue, they're slowed and grounded, so they can't dash.
Your basic combo: activate Q, throw W behind you, approach the enemy and knock them into a puddle while continuing to attack.
And if you need to initiate a fight, use W together with Q. Run up to your opponent, throw him over your back, and continue attacking.
during these 25 seconds of the ultimate's duration, his Q also applies the Heavy Wounds effect.
